attributes.action: Free travel for trains limited to each term of collage and university students
attributes.additional_details: People who struggle with money in this cost of living crisis need a way to get to collage or university, which unfortunately costs money which sometimes isn't cheep for us young people. Make a educational rail card for there travel from and too collage or university to make trains free limited to only the terms, (Summer term, Winter term, etc). Using proof of education, i.e collage or university ID. This gives students including myself less stress on money to getting the right to free education.
